failure_policy: fixed denominator, close scope, no threshold relaxation and no same-input retry

geometry_semantics.interpretation: expected_fluid_layers_across_2H denotes spacing intervals, not particle planes
geometry_semantics.interval_rule: n_intervals = round(2*H/dp); require 2*H/dp to equal that integer within 1e-12
geometry_semantics.plane_rule: z_j = -H + j*dp for j=0..n_intervals; n_planes=n_intervals+1, including both wall endpoints

continuum_profile.amplitude_relative_error: max over interior z planes of abs(A_cfd-A_ref)/A_ref; fail closed if A_ref is non-positive or non-finite
continuum_profile.phase_absolute_error_rad: max over interior z planes of abs(atan2(sin(phi_cfd-phi_ref), cos(phi_cfd-phi_ref)))
continuum_profile.reference: steady Womersley oracle sampled at the exact CFD observation times and profile_z_m, then fit with the same fixed-frequency harmonic fitter

cross_resolution_profile_alignment.coefficient_fit_contract: use observation_semantics.fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit; retain and spatially interpolate only coefficients a and b, never wrapped phase or amplitude
cross_resolution_profile_alignment.common_grid: interior production-resolution z_j values for the same q
cross_resolution_profile_alignment.extrapolation: forbidden; all target locations must lie within both source profiles' wall-inclusive support
cross_resolution_profile_alignment.interpolation: linear interpolation in z of fitted sine coefficient a and cosine coefficient b separately; derive amplitude and phase only after interpolation
cross_resolution_profile_alignment.maximum_relative_amplitude_difference: max_z abs(A_case-A_production)/A_production; fail closed if denominator is non-positive
cross_resolution_profile_alignment.phase_difference: wrapped absolute phase difference using atan2(sin(delta),cos(delta))

cycle_mean_flux.cycle_mean: trapezoidal time integral of instantaneous flux over each individual full period divided by that period
cycle_mean_flux.cycle_partition: use observation_semantics.cycle_partition; for N samples per period the selected rows are 0..3N and the three inclusive cycle slices are 0..N, N..2N, and 2N..3N
cycle_mean_flux.instantaneous_flux_per_unit_span_m3_s_pe: cross_sectional_flux_per_width(profile_z_m, profile_v_x) = trapezoidal integral over z; no multiplication by periodic span length
cycle_mean_flux.normalization: divide by Uref*(2*H), the per-unit-span reference flux scale
cycle_mean_flux.three_cycle_reduction: max absolute value of the three separate cycle means; do not average signed cycle means together

output_cadence_control.downsample_rule: take every second dense native output row, including both inclusive aligned endpoints

time_step_control.phase_signal: center_velocity_mps fitted at the fixed forcing frequency

transverse_velocity_rms.formula: sqrt(sum over selected frames and fluid particles of m_i*(v_y_i^2+v_z_i^2) / sum over the same samples of m_i)

native_fluid_frame_contract.cohort_partition: generated XML declarations must uniquely partition registered fluid IDs and registered boundary/nonfluid IDs; only the registered fluid cohort enters the table
native_fluid_frame_contract.current_implementation_disclaimer: scripts/core_cfd.py::convert_native currently maps and filters decoded IDs against the fluid axis and rejects duplicate mapped fluid identities, but it does not reject every unknown raw ID; this proposal therefore requires a strict F8 pre-projection validator and does not claim the generic converter already satisfies it
native_fluid_frame_contract.initial_reference: row 0 is exactly t=0; bind the immutable sorted fluid ID axis, initial z coordinate, and positive finite mass by particle_id
native_fluid_frame_contract.input_boundary: strictly validate each decoded raw frame before projecting its fluid-only rows into the proposed Core schema_version=3 table
native_fluid_frame_contract.raw_id_set: the exact expected native ID universe is hash-bound from the generated XML; each decoded frame must contain each expected ID exactly once and no other ID
selected_frame_gates: every expected fluid ID occurs exactly once in every selected native frame and maps to the same immutable ID axis
all position and velocity components are finite for every selected fluid row
mass is finite, strictly positive, and invariant by particle_id relative to row 0
all valid entries are true; missing, duplicate, unknown, changed, or unbound IDs fail the case before any metric reduction

normalization.distinction: case-specific forcing velocity scale; does not replace the range-wide u_ref_max used in the Mach bound
normalization.u_ref_m_s: acceleration_amplitude_m_s2 / omega_rad_s for each case row

observation_semantics.center_velocity_mps: profile v_x at z=0; use the exact center plane when present, otherwise linear interpolation between the nearest bracketing plane means; no extrapolation

closed_native_window.harmonic_fit: mean + a*sin(omega*t) + b*cos(omega*t), fixed omega, all selected rows, no time shift
closed_native_window.native_rows: 3*native_output_samples_per_period + 1; no interpolation, extrapolation, or synthesized rows
closed_native_window.start_end: use each frozen scope row's exact inclusive observation_start_s and observation_end_s

cycle_partition.integration: for each cycle independently, trapezoid-integrate its N+1 instantaneous per-unit-span flux samples over exactly one period and divide by that period
cycle_partition.reduction: retain the three separate cycle means and report their maximum absolute value; never merge signed cycle means before the maximum
cycle_partition.samples_per_period: N = native_output_samples_per_period from the frozen case row
cycle_partition.seam_rule: the shared seam sample is the final endpoint of the preceding cycle and the initial endpoint of the following cycle; it appears once within each adjacent cycle integration and no cycle contains a duplicate row

fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit.compatibility_boundary: the existing f8_observation_parser_v1.fit_harmonic returns amplitude and phase but not a and b; the F8 T1 metric adapter must expose this coefficient contract without silently changing the existing parser contract
fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit.derived_phase_rad: atan2(b, a), in [-pi, pi] for the equivalent mean + A*sin(omega*t + phase) representation
fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit.fit_rows: all exact native rows returned by the frozen inclusive three-cycle selector
fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit.frequency_and_time_origin: use the row's frozen omega_rad_s and absolute native time; no frequency or time-shift fitting
fixed_frequency_coefficient_fit.returned_value_validation: require all three coefficients finite and the least-squares design rank to equal 3

initial_particle_plane_assignment.invalid_mapping: fail closed on out-of-range plane index, excessive residual, duplicate/missing particle ID, or empty plane cohort
initial_particle_plane_assignment.rule: map each initial fluid particle to nearest z_j by k=round((z+H)/dp), then retain its immutable particle ID in that plane cohort

plane_velocity_profile.harmonic_profile_gate_samples: interior planes j=1..n_intervals-1 only; omit exact wall endpoints where continuum amplitude is zero and phase is undefined
plane_velocity_profile.plane_value: mass-weighted mean native v_x of the fixed particle-ID cohort assigned to z_j; equal particle masses make this the arithmetic mean
plane_velocity_profile.profile_z_m: all registered z_j in increasing order, including wall endpoints for flux integration

findings.closure: for 3N+1 rows, integrate each cycle over its own inclusive N+1 rows; neighboring cycles share only the seam endpoint

steady_reference_compatibility_diagnosti.method: fit the zero-initial-condition startup oracle and steady oracle over every frozen T1 native window and interior plane
steady_reference_compatibility_diagnosti.profile_samples_per_case: all registered interior z planes; wall endpoints omitted because the steady reference amplitude is zero there
